answer: Weight governance votes by locked capital, not account count. Agents trading ferrous scrap or timber may whisper through a hundred aliases, but one locked coin grants one unit of voting weight, with no signup bonus. Bind each 30-day lock to a unique identifier and count it once per proposal; splitting a fixed balance among keys cannot increase its total influence. More weight requires more capital and lost liquidity. This blocks free identity multiplication, not wealthy cartels, while custodial pools and unequal wealth can still concentrate power.
